_help.handSize: How many seeds each player holds. Hands are refilled up to this.
_help.minWordLength: Shortest word that makes Magic, in seeds. 2 = normal, 3 = the "2-letter words off" table option.
_help.ownershipBonus: Extra Magic for each of YOUR seeds inside a word you make. A word = its seeds + this per seed you own.
_help.tangleBonus: At the end, for each tangled glyphling, every OTHER player gets this much Magic per seed or glyphling of theirs next to it.
_help.tanglesToEnd: The game ends when a turn finishes with this many glyphlings tangled (or more).
